A0.statement: C_e is diagonal on f_k with lambda_k = a + 2b cos(theta + 2 pi k/3). The axial character f_0 carries the largest lambda exactly when theta lies in (-pi/3, pi/3) mod 2 pi (identities above). At theta = +-2/9 tau sits on f_0; e and mu sit on the conjugate characters f_1, f_2.

A1.statement: Every word in C_e, C_e^dagger and S, every trace and the identity commute with S, hence with C_e. With C_e nondegenerate, an operator commuting with C_e is diagonal on the f_k, so its eigenbasis is the charged-lepton basis and U_PMNS is a permutation matrix times phases: every angle is 0 or 90 degrees and J = 0. Spurion form (all orders): if T(Y) obeys T(U Y V^dagger) = U T(Y) U^dagger for all unitary U, V, write Y = U_L D V_R^dagger; then T(Y) = U_L T(D) U_L^dagger and T(D) = P T(D) P^dagger for every diagonal phase P, so T(D) is diagonal and T(Y) is diagonal in the left mass basis of Y.

A2.statement: For a real vector v, <f_2|v> = conj(<f_1|v>). With e and mu on f_1, f_2 (A0), every neutrino eigenbasis that is real in the counter basis gives abs(U_e i) = abs(U_mu i), i = 1, 2, 3.

A3.statement: Counter basis (or any basis unbiased to the f_k): abs(U)^2 = 1/3, abs(J) = 1/(6 sqrt3), the largest value of a 3 x 3 unitary; sin^2 theta13 = 1/3 in every column order.

A4.statement: If e sat on f_0 (DECLARED theta_e = 2/9 + 2 pi/3; no source), A2 applies to the mu and tau rows: abs(U_mu i) = abs(U_tau i), so theta23 = 45 degrees and cos delta = 0 whenever s12 c12 s13 is nonzero; abs(U_e i)^2 = (v_i . (1,1,1))^2/3 for a real basis {v_i}.
